versions.content: function SyncToStorage [SWS_PER_00049] Upstream: RS_PER_00002 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00128 , RS_AP_00129 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < void > SyncToStorage () noexcept; Flushes changed key-value pairs of the Key-Value Storage to the physical storage. SyncToStorage may be delayed by an ongoing call from another thread to RemoveAllKeys, DiscardPendingChanges, SetValue, RemoveKey, RecoverKey, or ResetKey.
